meta.title: 生活感就是不要摆拍 | 普通人自然拍照法
meta.title_en: Candid Life = Stop Posing | Natural Photo Tips for Ordinary People
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 自然生活感

scenes.context: 摄影师让你「自然点」，其实是最不自然的指引；让你「摆个姿势」，手更不知道往哪放。核心问题是把摆拍当指令。语域：拍照教学，先破题。
sentences: 最不自然的指引，就是这句「自然点」。
The most unnatural direction of all is the phrase 'just be natural'.
unnatural direction（不自然的指引）
他说摆个姿势，你手更不知道怎么摆了。
When he says 'strike a pose,' your hands get even more confused.
strike a pose（摆个姿势）
姿势不是摆出来的，是动出来的。
A pose isn't struck — it's moved into.
moved into（动出来的）
paraphrase: 摆个姿势 → strike a pose / get into a pose
strike a pose · get into a pose
动出来的 → moved into / born from motion
scenes.speak: The most unnatural direction of all is the phrase 'just be natural'. When he says 'strike a pose,' your hands get even more confused. A pose isn't struck — it's moved into.

scenes.context: 正确的做法是用动作链代替摆拍：给一个连续的动作（比如边走边撩头发、喝水），摄影师抓拍，自然感就出来了。语域：拍照教学，方法输出。
sentences: 正确的应该是用动作链，代替摆拍。
The right way is to use an action chain instead of posing.
an action chain（动作链）
姿势不是摆出来了，是动出来了。
The pose isn't something you strike — it's something you move into.
move into（动出来）
你只需要动起来，剩下交给快门。
All you need to do is move — let the shutter handle the rest.
let the shutter handle（交给快门）
paraphrase: 动作链 → an action chain / a sequence of motion
交给快门 → let the shutter handle it / let the camera catch it
let the shutter · camera catches it
scenes.speak: The right way is to use an action chain instead of posing. The pose isn't something you strike — it's something you move into. All you need to do is move — let the shutter handle the rest.

scenes.title_en: Use Live Mode to Catch the Best Frame
scenes.context: 实操方法：饮料会和手机的实况模式（Live Photo）配合。先按快门开始录，后面再去编辑里挑最好的一帧作为封面照，怎么拍都会有一张可以的。语域：拍照教学，实操建议。
sentences: 饮料会和手机的实况模式。
Pair the drink shot with your phone's Live mode.
Live mode（实况模式）
先拍手，后面再去编辑里面调整最好的一张，是为封面照编。
Press the shutter first, then pick the best frame in editing for your cover photo.
the best frame（最好的一帧）；cover photo（封面照）
怎么都会有一张可以的。
No matter what, you'll get at least one good one.
at least one good one（总会有一张能用的）
paraphrase: 挑最好的一帧 → pick the best frame / choose the sharpest shot
总有一张 → at least one good one / one winner every time
scenes.speak: Pair the drink shot with your phone's Live mode. Press the shutter first, then pick the best frame in editing for your cover photo. No matter what, you'll get at least one good one.

scenes.context: UP主自我介绍是拍手，并顺带宣传手机摄影课在招生。核心方法就一句话：别摆拍，动起来。语域：拍照教学，轻松收尾。
sentences: 我是你们的拍手，JJ包江江。
I'm your photographer — JJ Bao Jiangjiang.
your photographer（你们的拍手）
动女生的手机摄影课正在招生中。
My phone-photography course for girls is now open for enrollment.
open for enrollment（招生中）
生活感就是不要摆拍。
Candid life simply means: stop posing.
candid life（生活感）
paraphrase: 招生中 → open for enrollment / now taking students
别摆拍 → stop posing / drop the pose
scenes.speak: I'm your photographer — JJ Bao Jiangjiang. My phone-photography course for girls is now open for enrollment. Candid life simply means: stop posing.

practice: 破题：说最不自然的指引
The most unnatural direction of all is 'just be natural'.
Use an action chain instead of posing — move into the pose.
Press the shutter first, then pick the best frame in editing.
Candid life simply means: stop posing.
pitfalls: Be natural is the most not natural.
The most unnatural direction of all is 'just be natural'.
「最不自然的指引」用 the most unnatural direction，不要逐字翻译。
The pose is not made, is moved.
A pose isn't struck — it's moved into.
「摆姿势」用 strike a pose；「动出来」用 move into。
「实况模式」是 Live mode / Live Photo，不是 live model。
No matter what, you'll get at least one good one.
「总会有一张可以」用 at least one good one。
shifts: 用 strike a pose（摆姿势）、action chain（动作链）、Live mode（实况模式）、best frame（最好一帧）
用 candid（抓拍感）、moved into（动出来）、let the shutter handle（交给快门）
用 pick the best frame（挑最好一帧）、cover photo（封面照）、one winner（出片）
